text_block_list.text:
The moment Jungle Pocket returned, she 
slammed her forehead against the wall.
choice_data_list: Pocket! Don't blame yourself so much—

text_block_list.text:
A hollowed expression and quiet words. 
Feeling an instinctive fear at a demeanor 
completely opposite from usual, a cold 
sweat breaks out. But—
choice_data_list:
(If I back down now, I don't deserve to be 
a Trainer!)

text_block_list.text:
Feeling responsible for the losing streak, 
I slammed my head against the wall with 
just as much force as her. For a moment, I 
could have sworn I saw stars.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Finally awake, huh. Good grief, what 
were you doing?
choice_data_list: That's the usual Pokke... What a relief.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...My bad. I was way too hot-headed just 
now.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to fire myself up. To tell 
myself, "No matter how many times I lose, 
I ain't ever givin' up."
choice_data_list:
Now that you've got your pep back, all 
that's left is to prove them wrong!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket

"Haha. Then you're definitely gonna win 
next time!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Even if I lose, I ain't stoppin'. I'm 
gonna keep pushing forward no matter how 
far it takes me!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! From one stubborn soul to another, 
let's take this as far as we can go...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll blow past those conceited bastards 
and reclaim who I really am...!
